definition: a long round shape with flat circle ends
description: In a harvested field at golden hour, a young man in a checked flannel shirt, white T-shirt, jeans, sunglasses and brown boots balances with his arms spread wide on top of a huge round hay bale lying on its side, a long cylinder of tightly rolled straw. He steps along it, wobbling and waving his arms. More bales stand in a row behind him, sheep run past, a black-and-white sheepdog trots alongside, and a farmer stands by a tractor and a gate with his hands on his head.
